name: Home Assistant
tagline: Home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
description: Home Assistant connects lights, sensors, thermostats and thousands of other devices and services, and automates them, all running on your own server without a cloud.
postInstall: Open it and create the owner account, then name your home and its location.
Devices found by network discovery (mDNS) may not show up on their own: add them by their address in Settings > Devices & services.
USB radios (Zigbee, Z-Wave) are not passed to the container; use a network coordinator or a radio on another machine.
